project_title: Provision of Cash Assistance to Syrian Refugees in Lebanon
short_description: PROVISION OF CASH ASSISTANCE TO SYRIAN REFUGEES IN LEBANON
long_description: The main objective of UNHCR's multi-purpose cash assistance is to contribute to raising the income of beneficiary families to support them in meeting their basic needs such as paying rent and purchasing medicines. In addition to reducing the risk of exploitation for the most vulnerable refugee families as well as the risk of child and gender protection. UNHCR provides cash cards in the amount of USD 175 for 4,244 most vulnerable Syrian refugee families in Lebanon to support them in meeting their basic needs such as shelter, food and medicine. Families can withdraw the cash from any ATM in Lebanon and purchase the goods and services they need at their own discretion without frequent travel to distribution points and waiting in line to get the goods. Markets in Lebanon provide technical capacity, adequate banking services and infrastructure to provide cash assistance that can meet the basic needs of refugees effectively, with an abundance food, shelter medicine, clothing, and other special items in the local markets, and easily accessible ATMs. Cash-based interventions have proven to be one of the most cost-effective and dignified forms of assistance and impose the lowest level of administrative costs. Providing cash directly to beneficiaries give refugees the freedom to decide how to use such money, and also provides additional benefits such as directly contributing to the local economy.

project_title: Operation of the Dialysis Center in Al Ghaydah District, Al Mahrah Governorate, Yemen
short_description: OPERATION OF THE DIALYSIS CENTER IN AL GHAYDAH DISTRICT, AL MAHRAH GOVERNORATE, YEMEN
long_description: Operating an integrated dialysis center in Al-Ghaydah District with the support of the Saudi Development and Reconstruction Program for Yemen. It is the only specialized dialysis center in the area that provides dialysis services to 37 patients per month, i.e. 444 regular sessions, and an average of 48 emergency session monthly, that equals about 540 dialysis sessions per month, thus, the center will be conduct 12,960 sessions during the full duration of the project (24 months). The center is equipped with advanced dialysis devices, and a water treatment plant. It will also include a laboratory for blood and chemical tests to monitor the patients, a mini blood bank to provide blood transfusions during the dialysis sessions, in addition to a pharmacy that provides medicines for patients with renal insufficiency and a clinic specializing in kidney diseases. The need for this project arises from the lack of specialized centers in this field in the region due to the damage to the health sector caused by to the targeting of health facilities by the Houthi militia and the closure of most private health facilities, or the low level of services, the high cost of treatment, and the inability of many patients to bear its cost, with a population of more than 88,594 people living in the region.

project_title: Development of adaptable educational resources in the areas of schools re-enrollment, education in emergencies and transition to recovery and peace Education Promotes Peace
short_description: DEVELOPMENT OF ADAPTABLE EDUCATIONAL RESOURCES IN THE AREAS OF SCHOOLS RE-ENROLLMENT, EDUCATION IN EMERGENCIES AND TRANSITION TO RECOVERY AND PEACE
long_description: The project aims to design and develop expedited educational content to establish alternative educational models, in addition to principles, concepts and contents related to social cohesion, citizenship and the prevention of extremism, and programs for a second educational opportunity to reduce school dropout. This project will be an approach for future interventions where it is only adapted according to the needs of the target region, as well as capacity-building and enabling to prepare and implement these programs in conflict and disaster areas. This will be achieved by issuing training manuals as follows: - The center's general policy and strategy guide for Humanitarian Intervention in the Education Sector in Disaster and Conflict Areas. - A framework on alternative education policies and strategies. - Multi-grade catch up and teaching package which includes several manuals for the teacher and decision maker. - A reference package in the field of intensifying curricula (brochures as models for different subjects). - Psychosocial support package in cases of education in a crisis (Handbooks for teacher, parent, and school administration). - Decision Maker's Handbook on 'Education in Response, Preparedness and Recovery Situations'. - Early Childhood Importance package in Crisis Situations (Teacher and Decision Maker Handbooks). - Educational integration guide for children with special needs (Handbooks for teacher and decision maker). - Handbook of non-formal education activities in emergency situations. - Tolerance education package and its different applications (Handbooks for Teacher and Decision Maker). - A teacher's Handbook to education against violence and extremism. - Education package on Citizenship and Shared Human Values (guidebooks for teacher, decision maker, curriculum development). The project includes sharing Saudi expertise and enabling them to prepare and implement in this field.
